variety_description: Early maturity, semi-dwarf, long-bold grain,  widely adaptable variety mainly grown as direct seeded under rainfed and upland  conditions. Developed by CRRI, Hajaribag &amp; IRRI and released in 2008 for Jharkhand and Odhisa. Tolerant to drought and highly adaptable to water scarce and upland environments. Excellent grain and eating quality with low glycemic index.
